deleteAccount.sectionSummary: This permanently removes your login and related data. Counts below are from the server; open full details for the complete list.
deleteAccount.sectionDescription: The server permanently removes your user row and related data according to the list below. Organizations you own are deleted entirely (team chat, news, members). Organizations where you are only a member stay, but you are removed and your messages there are deleted.
deleteAccount.fallbackDetail: Unable to load the live summary (update the app or backend). When you delete your account, the server removes your login, profile, settings, addresses, devices, todos you own, organization memberships, organizations you own (and all of their data), org chat and news you authored, sessions, in-app messages to you, notification read markers, invitations you sent, and OTP history — matching database rules.
deleteAccount.confirmSheetMinimal: Removes your login and ends all sessions. Orgs you own are deleted entirely; as a member elsewhere you leave and your messages there are deleted. You cannot restore this account.
deleteAccount.confirmLead: You will be signed out and cannot recover this account. Below is what the server removes or updates for your user right now.
deleteAccount.confirmMessage: After deletion you must register again with the same email if it is still available.
deleteAccount.sheetFooterNote: Owned organizations are deleted as a whole (all members lose access). Todos created by others that only assigned you will keep the task but clear your name.

items.footerWarning: Organizations you own are deleted completely: every member loses access and all org data (chat, news, invites, etc.) is removed. In orgs where you are only a member, you leave and messages you posted there are deleted. On todos owned by others where you were the assignee, only your assignment is cleared—the tasks stay.
